## Catching up? Recreate this block's starting objects

Missed an earlier block, or restarted R? Run this in your project. It makes
`penguins_complete` as Block 1 does, and `theme_project()` as Block 3 does. If
you have no `R/functions/plot_functions.R` yet, save the `theme_project()`
lines there too, so that later scripts can `source()` it.

```{r, eval = FALSE, file = here::here("files", "catch-up", "day3-figures.R")}
```
:::
